title: Rho Bank Plus: Margin Lending Guide and Interest Rates
summary: Rho Bank Plus Margin Lending Guide specifies a 7.0% APR margin interest rate and a maximum available margin lending limit of $62,500 (subject to eligibility and collateral). It outlines how to request a margin advance, how interest accrues (including daily/monthly estimate formulas), repayment flexibility, and risk-management best practices.
